name: A02_clip
prompt: 2D animated documentary scene, clean cel shading, bold outlines, flat muted earthy colors, consistent style in every frame. Real-time speed, not slow motion. The two brown mules walk side by side from left to right at a normal, purposeful working pace, about one full stride every second, leaning into their harness as they pull the heavy wooden wagon heaped with oak firewood; their legs move in a natural four-beat walking gait, hooves lifting and striking the stones, heads nodding in time with each step, ears flicking, tails swishing. The big spoked iron-rimmed wagon wheel turns steadily and rolls over the ruts. Puffs of dust kick up from the hooves and the wheel and drift back in the sunlight. The golden grass at the road edge sways in the breeze. The camera stays low and tracks alongside the team at their walking speed, keeping both mules and the wheel in frame. Mid-morning light.
